acceptance_scope: Recorded native campaign predicates for music/loaded voices/audio regions, safe sampled particles, Ready course skins, four actual ride alignments and moving Clinger pose/facing. Bounded campaign cast coverage, exact Dash receipts, human listening, prepared fullcatalog and finite reserves are separate scopes.

animation.limit: C0 comparisons require identical actual actor/body identity. Family aggregates may mix actors and are excluded. Bounded retention omits earlier details. HealingFly and serpent proxies are outside the server observer ordinary-actor loop.
animation.per_family_visibility_limit: All29 families occur in retained client rows;27 have a retained Canonical row. Walker andRobot occur only during fallback in bounded retained rows. Whole-stage gate Ready counters are not per-family proof. Later canonical visibility for those families is unobserved, not a failure; independent native prepared catalog coverage is separate.

audio.limit: IsLoaded, play events and raw PlaybackLoudness are actual observations. No event means unobserved; a short cue can miss 0.5-second loudness sampling. No loading latency is inferred.

resource_evidence.limit: God Mode keeps stock while actual attempts/deaths advance. Six spawns/five respawns do not establish the finite attempt cap of four; original strict checks remain in the separate CLI summary.

console.limit: Representation warnings remain reported. Later Ready/visible samples do not turn warnings into zero-warning acceptance; observed Lua-error count is separate.

course.limit: Ready/Pending/fallback counts are full-stage observer counters; first plus last12 samples provide bounded detailed states, not exact asset loading times.

structures.limit: Client bounded counts confirm geometry observed, not exhaustive per-kind native fixture coverage.

course.transient_asset_content_status_limit: Actual retained Clinger fallback contains6Failure and4Loading content status observations. Later retained Canonical observations and last sampled skin contents areSuccess. Gate failedSamples=0 is separate from transient per-content failures and console warnings.

dash.limit: Stage1 records22 source-frame49 observations. Terminal bounded details omit those earlier rows. This histogram does not prove a matching same-attack receipt. Attempt28 dedicated same-body profile3 receipt evidence belongs to source9737089 and remains separate.

limits: Studio God Mode diagnostic, not finite reserve, public-server or manual-device acceptance.
